label: The meditator thinks is the selected-bearer thinking premise on the idea frame
note: The same proposition on the idea frame's carrier: MeditatorThinks I unfolds (through ThinkingRootFork.Thinks) to 'some episode e occurs and the meditator I.me bears e', which is SelectedBearsOccurringThought with Occurs := I.Occurs, Bears := I.Bears and the selected being := I.me. Verified for every idea frame as meditatorThinksIff (Iff.rfl), a Comparator-checked theorem of the restated-premise controls result. Same occurrence and bearer senses (DEF-THOUGHT-OCCURRENCE, DEF-THOUGHT-BEARER). The equivalence holds at that instantiation: the selected-bearer premise is stated for any occurrence and bearing relations and any selected being, the cogito premise for the meditator of an idea frame, so it is the selected-bearer premise with the selection fixed as the meditator, not a claim that every selected being is a meditator. The records stay distinct (Cartesian idea-of-the-infinite route and Round 3 cogito-base grounding route, different carriers, frozen Challenges); no argument is registered in either direction.
